keys: Items are ordered background to foreground
en: Items are ordered background to foreground
zh_TW: 道具依序由背景排到前景

keys: Compose your scene with extra items
en: Compose your scene with extra items

keys: If the Scene has Pinned Items, they will be excluded if the active model does not match
en: If the Scene has Pinned Items, they will be excluded if the active model does not match
zh_TW: 場景裡釘在模型上的道具，如果目前的模型不同就不會載入

keys: Load a model from a folder on this computer
en: Load a model from a folder on this computer
zh_TW: 從這台電腦的資料夾載入模型
重新匯入 VTS 綁定

keys: The hotkey list is being built. Hotkeys can be set in the Musubi node editor for now.
en: The hotkey list is being built. Hotkeys can be set in the Musubi node editor for now.
zh_TW: 熱鍵清單製作中。目前可以先在結繩（節點編輯器）設定熱鍵。

keys: Yorishiro is a VTubing app with its own face tracker. Its app started as a fork of OpenVT by erodozer, released under the MIT license. Yorishiro is not the OpenVT project, please send problems with Yorishiro to Yorishiro.
en: Yorishiro is a VTubing app with its own face tracker. Its app started as a fork of OpenVT by erodozer, released under the MIT license. Yorishiro is not the OpenVT project, please send problems with Yorishiro to Yorishiro.
zh_TW: Yorishiro 是一套附自製臉部追蹤的 VTuber 軟體。它的 app 一開始 fork 自 erodozer 的 OpenVT（MIT 授權）。Yorishiro 不是 OpenVT 專案，Yorishiro 的問題請回報給 Yorishiro。

keys: "Live2D" and "Cubism" are trademarks of Live2D Inc. "VTube Studio" is a trademark of its respective owner. Yorishiro is not affiliated with them and does not include the Live2D Cubism SDK.
en: "Live2D" and "Cubism" are trademarks of Live2D Inc. "VTube Studio" is a trademark of its respective owner. Yorishiro is not affiliated with them and does not include the Live2D Cubism SDK.
zh_TW: 「Live2D」和「Cubism」是 Live2D Inc. 的商標，「VTube Studio」是其所有者的商標。Yorishiro 與他們沒有關係，也不包含 Live2D Cubism SDK。

keys: The app this one was forked from
en: The app this one was forked from
zh_TW: 本 app 的 fork 來源

keys: Game engine the app runs on
en: Game engine the app runs on

keys: Show screen buttons on the stage
en: Show screen buttons on the stage
zh_TW: 在舞台上顯示畫面按鈕

keys: Clickable buttons in the corner of the stage for hotkeys that have one. Off: keyboard hotkeys only.
en: Clickable buttons in the corner of the stage for hotkeys that have one. Off: keyboard hotkeys only.
zh_TW: 舞台角落可以用滑鼠點的按鈕，對應有設定畫面按鈕的熱鍵。關掉就只用鍵盤熱鍵。

keys: No hotkeys yet. Add one to switch an expression or play an animation with a key.
en: No hotkeys yet. Add one to switch an expression or play an animation with a key.
zh_TW: 還沒有熱鍵。新增一個，就能用按鍵切換表情或播放動畫。

keys: Click, then press the keys. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
en: Click, then press the keys. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
zh_TW: 點一下再按下按鍵。Esc 取消，Backspace 清除。

keys: On: active only while the keys are held. Off: each press toggles.
en: On: active only while the keys are held. Off: each press toggles.
zh_TW: 勾選：按住時才有效。不勾：每按一次切換一次。

keys: This model has no expressions or animations.
en: This model has no expressions or animations.
zh_TW: 這個模型沒有表情或動畫。

keys: The dot is your face right now. Drag the two handles to the range you actually move: a narrower range reacts more. Smoothing steadies the motion but adds delay.
en: The dot is your face right now. Drag the two handles to the range you actually move: a narrower range reacts more. Smoothing steadies the motion but adds delay.
zh_TW: 圓點是你現在的臉。把兩個把手拉到你實際會動到的範圍：範圍越窄，反應越大。平滑會讓動作更穩，但會稍微延遲。

keys: Both eyes follow the more closed one. Steadier blinks, but no winks.
en: Both eyes follow the more closed one. Steadier blinks, but no winks.
zh_TW: 兩眼都跟著閉得比較多的那隻眼睛。眨眼更穩定，但不能眨單眼。

keys: Blinks every few seconds on its own. When the face is lost: only while the tracker cannot see you.
en: Blinks every few seconds on its own. When the face is lost: only while the tracker cannot see you.
zh_TW: 每隔幾秒自動眨一次眼。選「追蹤不到臉時」只在追蹤器看不到你時才自動眨。

keys: Guides you through a few expressions and sets the ranges to how your face moves.
en: Guides you through a few expressions and sets the ranges to how your face moves.
zh_TW: 引導你做幾個表情，依你的臉實際的動作範圍自動設定。

keys: Relax your face and look at the camera
en: Relax your face and look at the camera

keys: Open your mouth as wide as is comfortable
en: Open your mouth as wide as is comfortable

keys: No clear movement measured, nothing changed.
en: No clear movement measured, nothing changed.
zh_TW: 沒有量到明顯的動作，設定沒有改變。

keys: Move the model with your face
en: Move the model with your face

keys: Lean left or right and the model slides along, come closer and it grows.
en: Lean left or right and the model slides along, come closer and it grows.
zh_TW: 往左右移動時模型跟著滑動，靠近鏡頭時模型變大。

keys: Your glasses reflect the screen, so blinks and winks can be missed. Turn the screen brightness down, light the room a little more, or tilt your glasses slightly.
en: Your glasses reflect the screen, so blinks and winks can be missed. Turn the screen brightness down, light the room a little more, or tilt your glasses slightly.
zh_TW: 眼鏡反射了螢幕的光，眨眼可能偵測不到。可以調低螢幕亮度、讓房間亮一點，或稍微調整眼鏡角度。

keys: Shown on the preview head. Detection only notices glasses that reflect the screen.
en: Shown on the preview head. Detection only notices glasses that reflect the screen.
zh_TW: 會顯示在預覽頭上。自動偵測只認得出有反光的眼鏡。

keys: port %s is in use by another program
en: port %s is in use by another program
zh_TW: 連接埠 %s 被其他程式占用

keys: yorishiro-tracker is not installed at %s. Run `uv sync` in the tracker folder.
en: yorishiro-tracker is not installed at %s. Run `uv sync` in the tracker folder.
zh_TW: 在 %s 找不到 yorishiro-tracker。請在 tracker 資料夾執行 `uv sync`。
啟動追蹤器中（第一次啟動要載入模型）

keys: tracker stopped (exit code %s), see the log
en: tracker stopped (exit code %s), see the log
zh_TW: 追蹤器停止了（結束代碼 %s），請看紀錄
校正中，請保持自然表情

keys: A Live2D model folder (with a .model3.json file) or a VRM file.
en: A Live2D model folder (with a .model3.json file) or a VRM file.
zh_TW: Live2D 模型資料夾（裡面有 .model3.json 檔）或 VRM 檔。

keys: Drag the model to move it, scroll to resize, Shift + scroll to tilt. The gear in the corner opens all settings.
en: Drag the model to move it, scroll to resize, Shift + scroll to tilt. The gear in the corner opens all settings.
zh_TW: 拖曳模型可以移動，滾輪調整大小，Shift + 滾輪旋轉。角落的齒輪可以打開所有設定。

keys: No face tracking input is selected.
en: No face tracking input is selected.
zh_TW: 還沒有選擇臉部追蹤來源。

keys: Another tracking input is selected, see the tracking settings.
en: Another tracking input is selected, see the tracking settings.
zh_TW: 目前用的是其他追蹤來源，詳情請看追蹤設定。

keys: Ready: your face is in view.
en: Ready: your face is in view.
zh_TW: 準備好了：已經看到你的臉。

keys: Running, but no face is in view. Sit in front of the camera with some light on your face.
en: Running, but no face is in view. Sit in front of the camera with some light on your face.
zh_TW: 追蹤器在執行，但畫面裡沒有臉。請坐到攝影機前，讓臉上有一點光。

keys: Starting the tracker. The first start takes a little longer.
en: Starting the tracker. The first start takes a little longer.
zh_TW: 正在啟動追蹤器，第一次啟動會久一點。
